BISMI ALLAH AL-RAHMAN AL-RAHIM. In the name
of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
Speaker: Dr. Rashad Khalifa
Description: Dr. Rashad Khalifa explains the procedure for the Friday congregational prayer, citing Sura 62:9 as an obligation on both men and women, and walks through each required element: an Azan mentioning God's name alone, two sermons that each open with "Alhamdu Lillah, La Elaha Ella Allah," a pause for repentance after the first, the closing call "Aqem Al-Salah," and a two-unit prayer in place of the usual four. The second half of the tape presents sample sermons, the first on seeking God's kingship, which opens from Luke 12:29-31 and covers religious priorities, the order of Zakat recipients, Hajj, and God as Al-Razaq the provider who gifts the prayers themselves to the believer. A further sermon treats marriage in Islam, which he says requires love built on real acquaintance and a dowry serving as the wife's security, then extends into self-discipline, the soul's strength over the body, polygamy in light of Muhammad's long monogamous marriage, and the argument that God hates divorce and protects the rights of women. Related recordings: the two sample sermons in the second half of this tape also appear separately as "32 - Friday Sermon Seek GOD's Kingship Over You and Everything Else Follows (03-25-1988)" and "33 - Friday Sermon Marriage Importance of Love, Muhammad's Example (04-08-1988)"; the companion tape on the five daily prayers referred to here is "17 - Principles of Contact Prayers Salat."
